title.zh: 授予达沃省Panabo市镇电灯、热力与动力系统特许经营权的法案
title.en: An Act to Grant the Municipality of Panabo, Province of Davao, a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System
title.orig: An Act to Grant the Municipality of Panabo, Province of Davao, a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp đặc quyền cho Thị trấn Panabo, Tỉnh Davao đối với hệ thống chiếu sáng, sưởi ấm và điện lực
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัมปทานแก่เทศบาล Panabo จังหวัด Davao สำหรับระบบไฟฟ้าแสงสว่าง ความร้อน และพลังงานไฟฟ้า
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan konsesi kepada Kotamadya Panabo, Provinsi Davao untuk sistem penerangan, pemanas, dan tenaga listrik
title.ms: Akta memberikan konsesi kepada Perbandaran Panabo, Wilayah Davao untuk sistem lampu, haba dan kuasa elektrik

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2402_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-six, there is granted to the Municipality of Panabo, Province and thirty-two, and to the provisions of the Constitution, approval of this Act, the right, privilege and authority to of Davao, for a period of twenty-five years from the as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred construct, maintain and operate an electric light, heat and power plant for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and/or power for sale within the limits of the said municipality.

In the event that the grantee shall purchase and secure from the National Power Corporation electric heat and power, the National Power Corporation is hereby authorized to negotiate and transact for the benefit and in behalf of the public consumers with reference to rates.

It is expressly provided that in the event the Government should desire to maintain and operate for itself the system and enterprise herein authorized, the grantee shall surrender its franchise and will turn over to the government all serviceable equipment therein at cost, less reasonable depreciation.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
